en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a stone statue of a robed man on a tall pedestal in a formal garden or small square, with evergreen trees and a wall in the background. The base of the statue bears the name "Antonio Rosmini." Printed red captions at the bottom read "Rovereto" and "Monumento Rosmini." There is handwritten cursive text across the lower margin and right side of the image.
